sources.title: Overview | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Desktop Manager decomposes goals into tracked tasks/workers with memory, review and external messaging.

sources.title: Supported Operating Systems | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: macOS 11+ Intel/ARM and Windows 10/11 x64 supported; Linux unsupported.

sources.title: Quick Start | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Local folders, SSH project directories and Cloud projects have separate setup; task states include Pending/Running/Completed/Error.

sources.title: Manager | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Manager plans stages/subtasks/dependencies and acceptance criteria, runs workers concurrently, retains outputs and questions, and imports past conversation memory.

sources.title: Multiple Managers | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Multiple Managers have separate identity, memory and tool settings.

sources.title: Automation | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Natural-language schedules create cron jobs; app must be active, otherwise runs are Missed and can be manually triggered.

sources.title: Bring Your Own Agent (BYOA) | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Workers can run Codex using existing local authentication or Claude Code via ACP with configured API providers; keys remain local.

sources.title: Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Built-in agents can use Anthropic/OpenAI/OpenRouter keys; Smart Suggestions and automatic compression do not support BYOK.

sources.title: Subagents | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Built-in and custom subagents use dedicated prompts/models; Planner and Reviewer can use multiple models concurrently.

sources.title: Rules | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Global rules and project AGENTS.md configure behavior, with project rules versioned in Git.

sources.title: MCP Integration | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Project/global MCP server configuration supports multiple servers, tools and credentials.

sources.title: Skills | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Reusable skill knowledge packs extend workflows.

sources.title: Integration | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Plugins connect GitHub, Stripe, Supabase, Notion and other tools with guided authentication.

sources.title: Plan Mode | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Plans clarify requirements, acceptance criteria and API structure; users edit/skip clarification and save plans as Markdown explicitly.

sources.title: Agent Mode | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Agent Mode executes with visible tools and approval prompts; mode changes are unavailable during active execution.

sources.title: Code Review | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Reviewer produces severity-ranked findings with paths/lines/confidence and selected fixes; global Review Rules and multiple model review are configurable.

sources.title: Workspace Isolation | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Git worktrees separate directory/branch/staging. Manual New Workspace is hidden, but supported workflows can create workspaces internally.

sources.title: Cloud Projects and Publishing | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Desktop creates distinct Cloud projects; working preview and resource limits gate publishing. Local files are not automatically uploaded.

sources.title: Verdent Cloud Overview | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Browser controls Cloud infrastructure for chat, code, previews, publishing, analytics and logs without Desktop installation.

sources.title: Overview | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: VS Code extension provides agent planning, verification and code diffs, with shared account credits.

sources.title: Managing Tasks | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Cloud tasks retain conversation/context/files/artifacts and can be reopened.

sources.title: Parallel Work and Multitasking | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Separate Cloud tasks progress independently; not local worktree management.

sources.title: Differences from Desktop | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Cloud does not document SSH workflows or Manager; Desktop and Cloud scopes differ.

sources.title: Version Control | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Cloud versioning uses project workspace flows; local repository controls should not be assumed.

sources.title: Credits and Plans | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Desktop and VS Code share credit pool, top-ups and dashboard balances; older trial table conflicts with 2.18 retirement.

sources.title: Billing Cycle and Rollover | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Monthly credit refresh and rollover follow billing-cycle policy.

sources.title: Configure Feishu SSO for Verdent Team | Verdent Docs
sources.finding: Verdent Team Owner configures Feishu SSO and up to five corporate domains; owner manages access, regular members authenticate.

sources.title: Verdent AI Pricing | Subscription Plans
sources.finding: Lite $5/month, Starter $19, Pro $59, Max $179. Teams $20/user/month; top-ups have no model markup and do not expire.

sources.title: Changelog · Verdent
sources.finding: Starting v2.18, Free Mode and Free Trial are retired and 100 welcome credits discontinued; AI use requires subscription.

sources.title: Verdent AI Privacy Policy
sources.finding: Privacy policy describes collected inputs/outputs and optional indexing embeddings, consent-based training and cross-border transfers.

sources.title: Verdent AI Security Policy
sources.finding: Vendor security policy says certifications are being pursued, describes US infrastructure/providers, server-routed AI requests and deletion.

sources.title: Terms of Use · Verdent
sources.finding: Vendor retains application code rights and restricts reverse engineering; recurring subscriptions/cancellation and tax-inclusive fees are described.
